prose: Show HN: Corral kills every command your agent starts. The author, an intern on an AI-agent backend, noticed agents leaving stray processes - tail -f, background jobs - running after exit, and built Corral to clean up the whole tree. A small tool addressing a real agent-ops annoyance.
highlights: Corral: kills every command your agent starts
